body:
event: message
data: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"tools":[{"description":"Search the available tool catalog by query and return the matching tools. The query is a case-insensitive regular expression tested against each tool's name and description. To match any of several keywords, separate them with `|` (for example, `weather|forecast`); a space matches literally, so a space-separated keyword list rarely matches. Use this to discover tools before invoking them.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Case-insensitive regular expression matched against each tool's name and description. Separate alternative keywords with `|` (for example, `weather|forecast`); spaces match literally."},"limit":{"type":"integer"},"cursor":{"type":"string","description":"Opaque pagination cursor from a prior search's nextCursor; pass it back to fetch the next page."}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"},"name":"search_tools"},{"description":"Invoke a tool discovered via search_tools by name, passing its arguments.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"arguments":{"type":"object"},"name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["name","arguments"],"type":"object"},"name":"invoke_tool"}]}}
